name: notify_pdmp
description: notify_pdmp: Notify the state Prescription Drug Monitoring Program of a DEA registration transfer.

dea_number.description: The provider's DEA number. Format: 2 uppercase letters followed by 7 digits. Example: BK4729183

state_code.description: The 2-letter US state abbreviation for the new registration state. Example: CA

facility_code.description: The facility code for the new registration location. Format: 2-4 uppercase letters, dash, 2 digits, 1 letter. Example: BWH-02A
